name: Omaha Public Library Volunteer (youth ages 11 to 18)
what_you_do: Volunteers help with library programs and special events. They gain skills like teaching, teamwork and leadership.
who_can_apply: Anyone age 11 or older. Youth ages 11 to 18 need a parent or legal guardian to approve. The page does not list a city or school rule.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The library says it can provide volunteer hours for court-related community service.
duration: Short-term or ongoing, depending on the task
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer form. There is one form for Central Library and another for all other branches. Youth and summer reading volunteers need a parent or guardian signature before starting.
notes: The library says it may not be able to place each applicant. It has the right to reject any application without reason. It reserves the right to do a background check or check references. Quote from the volunteer policy: OPL accepts volunteers ages 11 and older. The Central Library has its own volunteer form. It is linked on the volunteer page.
